about: Style browser grid: every scene x every style = 100 images. Prompt = style.prompt + ', ' + scene.content + ', ' + shared_suffix. Method: DECISIONS 2026-11-24. Settings are what round 1 ran with (2026-11-24).
shared_suffix: high angle view looking down at about 45 degrees, thin band of distant marsh and sky at the top, warm low sunset light, a few small red and white mushrooms, occasional puddles, no people, no text
negative: photo, photorealistic, 3d render, people, person, text, watermark, signature, frame, border

settings.model: SDXL base 1.0: sdxl/sd_xl_base_1.0_0.9vae.safetensors on MimicPC (no refiner: it pushes detail towards photo)
settings.controlnet: xinsir depth: SDXL/controlnet-depth-sdxl-1.0/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors in models/controlnet on MimicPC (from ComfyUI-Manager), strength 0.6, end 0.8 (too strong flattens the style)
settings.seed: one fixed seed per scene, same for every style

scenes.content: an old broken wooden boardwalk on posts crossing marsh water, dense tall reeds and cattails behind, a large still puddle reflecting the sky, muddy ground
a winding muddy path between low mossy grassy banks, shallow pools of still water, cattails in the foreground, a large weeping willow with exposed roots on the right
a small rickety wooden footbridge over a narrow stream, tall cattails and reeds framing both sides, a grassy path

a winding rutted muddy path with puddles and low mossy tufts through a dense reedbed, tall overlapping reeds and cattails on both sides, a still lily-pad pond in the reeds on the right, open reed marsh stretching to the horizon
